Planning Packages & Services

Expert destination wedding planning with transparent pricing and comprehensive service offerings tailored to your celebration style.

Wedding Exploration Service

Comprehensive wedding planning foundation for couples who want expert guidance in the early stages of destination wedding planning.

What's Included:

  • Venue sourcing & procurement
  • Budget development & Timeline design
  • Room block & group rates negotiation & arrangement
  • Personalized website for Guest RSVPs & information
  • Guest arrival management & professional transportation planning
Planning Investment $1,500

Our couples have a typical range of $800+ per guest for multi-day celebrations with accommodations separately tailored for your guests.

Full Wedding Service

Complete end-to-end wedding planning and on-site management for couples who want every detail expertly handled.

What's Included:

  • Full-service, on-site, multi-day event management
  • Vendor procurement, contractual oversight, & timeline synchronization
  • Budget Development with strategic monitoring & financial transparency
  • Destination discovery & assessment with logistical coordination
  • Room block & group rates negotiation & arrangement
  • Personalized website for Guest RSVPs & information
  • Guest arrival management
Investment Starting at $5,000 + 10% of total wedding investment

Pricing is customized based on guest count, location, duration, and specific requirements. Contact us for a detailed consultation and personalized quote.

Curated Honeymoon Planning

Personalized honeymoon planning that creates romantic escapes perfectly tailored to your relationship and travel style.

What's Included:

  • Destination curation based on your preferences
  • Luxury accommodation sourcing & booking
  • Personalized itinerary design & activity coordination
  • Travel logistics & transportation arrangements
  • Special experience booking & romantic touches
  • Travel support during your honeymoon
Planning Investment $250

Simple flat fee covers planning from booking through post-travel follow-up. No hidden costs or booking fees - just expert planning for your perfect honeymoon.
